               ALIS Valves is an Electric Remote Control Float Valve Manufacturer in India, offering reliable automatic water level control solutions for tanks, reservoirs, water towers and water supply systems. The Electric Remote Control Float Valve is a diaphragm-operated hydraulic control valve designed for automatic water level management. The valve uses a float switch and electrical control signal to automatically open or close the main valve according to the required water level. When the water level falls below the preset level, the control system allows the valve to open and replenish the tank. When the water reaches the required level, the valve closes and stops the water supply.

Electric Remote Control Float Valves are suitable for water treatment plants, municipal water distribution networks, industrial storage tanks, commercial buildings, irrigation systems and other water management applications. Their remote operation helps reduce manual intervention and supports efficient water level control. The appropriate valve selection depends on inlet pressure, required flow rate, tank capacity, pipeline size, electrical control requirements, body material and operating conditions. Selecting a compatible valve and control system helps provide reliable operation and effective water level regulation.

name: 3 Way Diaphragm Type Control Valve
paragraphs: 3 Way Diaphragm Type Control Valves are used in chemical processing, water treatment, pharmaceutical production, food and beverage processing and other industrial applications requiring controlled fluid mixing or distribution. Their suitability depends on the process media, diaphragm compatibility, operating pressure, temperature range and required flow characteristics. Important selection factors include valve size, port arrangement, flow capacity, pressure drop, diaphragm material, body construction and actuator requirements. Buyers should confirm whether the application requires mixing or diverting service, as the appropriate flow configuration depends on the valve’s internal design. For automated control, the actuator and control signal must be compatible with the plant’s process control system. Selecting the appropriate 3 way diaphragm type control valve helps provide accurate flow regulation, dependable fluid routing and reliable operation in compatible industrial processes.

               Alis Valves is a trusted Cage Guided Globe Control Valve Manufacturer & Supplier in India, offering high-performance control valves for demanding industrial applications involving high pressure differentials and precise process control. Designed with a cage-guided trim, these valves provide excellent plug stability, accurate flow regulation, low vibration, reduced noise, and extended service life. They are ideal for oil & gas, petrochemical, power generation, steam, chemical processing, refineries, and industrial automation systems.

Cage Guided Globe Control Valves are used in oil and gas facilities, refineries, chemical processing plants, power generation units, steam systems and other industrial process installations. Depending on the valve materials, trim design and pressure-temperature ratings, they can be selected for compatible liquids, gases and steam. Important selection factors include operating pressure, temperature range, differential pressure, flow coefficient (Cv or Kv), valve size, process media, cage and plug materials, required flow characteristics and seat leakage class. For high-pressure-drop applications, trim selection should also consider cavitation, flashing, erosion and noise-control requirements. Actuator sizing and control signal compatibility are important for achieving the required response and positioning accuracy. Selecting the appropriate cage design and valve configuration helps support stable flow regulation, reliable control performance and consistent operation under specified working conditions.
